Accommodations: 12 Bedrooms + Other (See Description), 12 Baths (Sleeps up to 32 ((This home does sleep up to 32 but an additional guest fee of $700 will be charged over 24) guests.6 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms per side. Please google us for additional contact information in case you want to discuss this property with us. Your group is large and fitting everyone in is difficult to imagine so give us a call, if you can't find us on Google, checkout our "30A vacation rental homes" for our contact info. All bookings do go through the VRBO site for both of our protection.
An ideal vacation home, Wally and Marimac offers the finest furnishings designed for those with discerning tastes. You can google us for further contact information, or go to our web site to see local things to do. It is 30a vacation rental homes.The home, side by side town homes, was designed with upscale amenities not typically present in a beach home, or for that matter, in most residential homes.

Pine floors, four gourmet kitchens, two each side, granite counter tops, residential elevators, private pools, spas, jetted tubs, wainscoting, exposed beam and trey ceilings serve as the foundation for your comfort.

Enjoy amazing Gulf views and sounds. Experience spectacular sunsets from over 1000 square feet of furnished balcony space.

Ceiling fans, hi-definition LCD TVs, Blu-ray DVD players and Internet "APP/widget" support enhance bedroom and living areas. Complementary broadband wireless Internet access serves your needs. Residential elevators provides comfortable access for stocking home with kitchen groceries or ease of access for elderly family members. Two full laundry facilities are available, one on each side.

In the morning, at lunch, or after an exhausting day of fun, enjoy the warmth of your family and friends in the comfort of a large upper level living areas that includes a gourmet kitchen with Wolf appliances, refrigerators/freezers, dishwashers, wine coolers and microwaves. Enjoy meals together on a hand-made large rough-hewn kitchen tables that can easily service a very large group or family. The adjacent living space to a large balcony that faces the gulf and overlooks the private pools.

The upper level offers a small private office area (although it is hard to get work done because of the great view), a half bathroom, and a large king suite (sleeps 2 ) with its own gulf view balcony and a private full bathroom. Times this by two (each side is a mirror image).

On the second level are two king bedroom suites (sleeps 4) with private separate shower/tubs (two jetted), walk-in closets and balconies with Gulf views. A bunk rooms with 2 twin beds (sleeps 2) with a private full bathroom located here. Full laundry facilities with a washer and dryer are centrally located on the second level. Again time two since they are mirrored on each side.

Teens love the ground level recreation room with armoire and twin/full/trundle bunk bed (sleeps4). Also on this level are a full kitchen, range, refrigerator, microwave, ice maker, two queen Murphy bed (sleeps 2), two queen sleeper sofa (sleeps 2), and full bathroom. You got it times two!

Exit the back of the home where a beautifully landscaped courtyard with its small private pool, spa, outdoor shower, patio, and gas grill await for family lounging or evening cook-outs.

Just 100 yards from Wally and Marimac's private back gate is level (no steps to climb) access to one of the most beautiful beaches in America. This is on the south side of Hwy 30-A which means no roads to cross to the beach. This is especially great for the safety of children.

Inlet Beach is a gorgeous, uncongested "sugar sand" beach that adjoins the east side of Rosemary Beach and the west end of Camp Helen State Park and salt water Lake Powell at the east end of Scenic 30A. Sunning, swimming, fishing, and kayaking are available.

For those that want to get up and out there is a short bike ride or one-mile walk to Rosemary Beach shops and restaurants. A newly built outdoor shopping mall, called Pier Park is a short 10-minute drive east on 98 (toward Panama City) that has a large cinema, shops, restaurants, and an amusement park. Nearby golf courses include Camp Creek Golf Club, Shark's Tooth, Bay Pointe, Santa Rosa Beach Golf Club, The Hombre, and Burnt Pine. This area is a hidden paradise for golfers.

We are confident that you will enjoy your stay at Wally and Marimac. We are thrilled to share our home with you and hope that you will create lifetime memories and unwind from the stresses of everyday life.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
